<thought>Based on the exact mass (114.068 Da) the molecular formula is C₆H₁₀O₂. The DBE of 2 and the ¹³C NMR signals (one carbonyl ~168 ppm, two sp² carbons ~144 and 130 ppm, and three aliphatic carbons ~22, 21, 19 ppm) fit an α,β‑unsaturated carboxylic acid: CH₃‑CH₂‑CH=CH‑CH₂‑COOH. The corresponding SMILES is “CC=CCC(=O)O”. This SMILES is valid and matches the spectral data.</thought>
<final_answer>CC=CCC(=O)O</final_answer>
